evidence_gaps: No sanitised runtime forensics branch available.
No data on live executed slippage, gas/priority fees impact, or strategy profitability.
Cannot evaluate execution failure rates or their economic impact on edge.

proposals.downside_risk: No live capital risk. Minor increase in compute and database storage requirements for shadow evaluations.

evidence.detail: The New Liquidity Quality strategy currently filters out opportunities with net_edge_bps < 6. Without runtime forensics, we lack evidence on whether 6 bps is the correct threshold for new pools.

proposals.expected_effect: Increased SHADOW hit rate for new pools, generating a statistical distribution of post-friction PnL for 3-6 bps edges.
proposals.rationale: By reducing the threshold for purely SHADOW evaluation, the strategy engine can collect evidence on lower-edge opportunities without risking live capital, helping establish the true profitability boundary.
proposals.shadow_test: Lower min_net_bps to 3 in SHADOW mode. Measure whether >=45% of entries between 3 and 6 bps yield a positive durable money-weighted PnL (accounting for max slippage, gas and failure rates).

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote Cross Venue Net Arbitrage to CANARY
rejected_ideas.reason: Missing runtime forensics. No evidence of durable money-weighted NET P&L after fees, slippage, and execution failures.

summary: Completed architecture-only strategy review. Evaluated the pure/stateless strategy definitions in cross_chain_strategy_signals.py and the SHADOW/CANARY state tracking. A SHADOW_MORE action is proposed to gather empirical data on new liquidity pool edges due to the missing runtime forensics.
